description:
A 50-page farm-themed coloring book designed for toddlers and young children. It features cows, sheep, pigs, horses, ducks, goats, chickens, and other farm animals in simple, bold illustrations intended for small hands.

The listing describes large 8.5 x 11 inch pages, single-sided printing to reduce bleed-through and allow tear-out, and benefits including creativity, focus, confidence, and fine motor skill development. It is presented as suitable for gifts, classroom activities, road trips, and quiet time.
